this task's own directory (it contains no .jsonl file; no self-exclusion rule is used)

Full-tree V0 hits on non-excluded, non-staging (kept) files = 0 at the measured snapshot

decision_rule.A0_HF14_SCOPE_VOCABULARY_BLIND: P4 and P5 both hold: the A0 after-scope total of 0 is V0-conditional, and a canonical-class path (never excludable) carries alias-closed HF-14 records

decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE_PIN_OR_CONTROL_FAILURE: any input pin drifts between T0 and T1, or any control C1-C9 fails

falsifier: A rubric-conformant reading in which author_asserts_supports=true is not the marker the rubric names (supports_claim=true), or a demonstration that ledger/theorems.jsonl is not in the scope artifact's canonical class / is excluded by classify(rel), or a snapshot at which the live canonical ledger contributes 0 alias-closed HF-14 records.
